_comment: Conditional fragment merged when manifest.hooks.memory_consolidation.enabled is true. Adds the FIRST-PARTY memory-consolidation SessionEnd hook (memory-consolidation-check.sh — brain-stem's own non-LLM hygiene consolidation, NOT claude-mem; claude-mem is an optional adopter-installed plugin). The installer deep-merges this fragment into the SessionEnd hooks array of the user's settings.json.
